svg.aria-label: Clinical groups record different measurements, so no single input space exists; keeping only common columns, imputing, or training one model per group each fail; this paper gives each group its own encoder into one shared space with one predictor and protects the group furthest from its own achievable loss.
svg.text: (b) One common model needs one input space
no column is shared by all;
(c) This paper: separate inputs, one shared space, one predictor
shared space, one target per outcome
